notes:
### New
- **Tracks you add to OpenCrate's own library are analysed:** in the
  background, one at a time, OpenCrate finds each track's tempo and a
  beatgrid (with the bars marked), shown in the track list and the
  player. Right-click a track → **Analyze** to redo it. The analysis part
  comes with the app (the download is a bit bigger, about 23 MB instead
  of 9 MB).

### Fixes
- Adding music to OpenCrate (files, folders, or dragging them in) no
  longer freezes the app. Behind the scenes it kept trying to analyse the
  new tracks over and over, thousands of times a second, even though the
  analysis part can't be installed yet.
